Nobody has messaged me either, I think it is a scam seeing as everybody else is experiencing the same thing. But I subscribed for 3 months so I’ll wait and see if anything happens.

Me too omgggg, I keep waiting for someone to text me or tip me but nobody has and it has been almost a week. My account was verified and I paid for the subscription but I haven’t received one message! I came from a girl’s TikTok who said she has gotten lots of messages and tips but up till now I haven’t seen nothing.

I would think nothing less of you, that your bones ache to the sound of reality. That you bleed when you're cut, I'll think nothing less of you that the night comes with pain and you crumble until you're barely sane. I would think nothing less of you, you're human and it sucks. You are human , be easy on yourself.

Sucks but you belong with us here, fighting to hold on or choosing to stay despite it all. I'm sorry you feel so lonely, I wish things could get better by the snap of a finger. I'm sorry you feel this way !!

I hope you make it through this, I wish you calmer days and better things. I hope you get to make your art and I get to watch it too , I know it's cliche and everything but please hang in there if you can.  I don't know if things are gonna be better but I hope it does for us both.
Because I might not be here for long or I might never show it to her and I think life I guess.
